summary: Four charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn; Searing Smite costs 2 (DC 13).
text: Four charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn; Searing Smite costs 2 (DC 13). Reference-only: Attack action spends 1 charge for Thrown 20/60 with automatic return until your next turn ends; a melee attack can spend 1 charge for Advantage and DC 13 Strength against Prone on hit.
